captions.detailed: A vertical-lift barrier panel featuring a rectangular safety mesh framed in orange, designed to slide vertically within two grey guide columns. A separate, rear-mounted vertical column houses a black rectangular counterweight block that moves along vertical rods. At the top of this rear column sits a pulley wheel, which links the counterweight and the front safety gate via a connecting cable. The base, top crossbeams, and pulley housing are colored black.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated vertical-lift barrier panel model in CadQuery. The assembly must include a main frame with grey guide columns and a black top beam, a sliding orange-framed mesh gate on a vertical prismatic joint, and a rear counterweight column containing a black counterweight block on a separate vertical prismatic joint, complete with a top pulley assembly.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame using box primitives for the vertical guide columns and horizontal crossbeams. Build the sliding gate by combining a rectangular frame with a grid of thin intersecting cylinders to form the wire mesh. Create the rear counterweight assembly using vertical cylindrical guide rods, a rectangular box for the counterweight, and a pulley wheel made of concentric cylinders. Define two prismatic joints (one for the gate sliding in the front guides and one for the counterweight sliding in the rear guides) and link their movements to simulate the cable-pulley mechanism.
